cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`])git[[:space:]]+commit '; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then printf 'BLOCKED: git commit on main is forbidden.

Recovery (no commits yet on main):
  git checkout -b feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name

Recovery (commits already on main, not yet pushed):
  git stash                                           # save uncommitted work
  git checkout -b feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name                 # branch carries the commits
  git checkout main                                    # back to main
  git reset --soft origin/main && git restore --staged .   # rewind without losing work
  git checkout feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name && git stash pop   # resume on feature branch

Never use git reset --hard. Full procedure: AGENTS.md > Workflow > AXIOM 1.
Note: origin enforces nothing on this repo (private, free plan) -- this hook is the enforcement.
' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`(])(go[[:space:]]+(build|test|vet)|golangci-lint[[:space:]]+(run|fmt)|gofmt|make) [^;]*\|[[:space:]]*(tail|head) ' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(--help|-h)([[:space:]]|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])set[[:space:]]+-o[[:space:]]+pipefail'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Go gate piped through tail/head without pipefail.

Bash reports the LAST pipeline stage exit status, so tail/head always exits 0 -- a RED gate gets recorded as green. tail -N can also truncate away the FAIL line you needed (AGENTS.md > Build & Test).

Use instead:
  go test ./... > gate.log 2>&1 && echo GATE-GREEN || echo GATE-RED
  grep -E "^(FAIL|ok|---)" gate.log

Or prefix with: set -o pipefail;

This hook matches COMMAND TEXT, not shell semantics -- a string that merely quotes such a pipeline also matches. Rephrase it or use the Write tool.

Known false positive: a make dry run (make -n) is blocked too, because make is matched as a class -- every target in this Makefile is a gate, and a loud refusal on a command that executes nothing is cheaper than a green record of a red gate. Drop the pipe or redirect to a file.
' >&2; exit 2; fi

Line(s) outside the list:
%s

Permitted, one per line, nothing else:
  Read .claude/agents/%s.md and follow it.
  Spec: <path>.md          -- or Spec-equivalent: <path>.md
  Design: <path>.md        -- omit the line when there is no design doc

Re-spawn with those lines only. Round history, gate results, a description or defence of the fixes, scope reminders and routing questions are contamination -- the reviewer re-derives all of it from the tree, and what it needs about a no-spec or no-design run is in the agent file, under What the prompt paths already tell you.
